text:
sara-partnerships: Quick sync  CloudScale wants to list in apac-sg-2 this week. They need A100 quotas, vGPU burst capacity, and KMS entitlement so customers can use CMKs. can the partnerships + infra workflow finish by EOD Wed?

devin-cloudops: need provider account mapping and exact SKU counts before I open a quota ticket.

mike-cloudscale: partner account cloudscale-p-993. Request: 4 x A100-80GB dedicated, 8 vGPU burst profiles, est ~120k vGPU hours/month. CMK: partner brings key, we need entitlement + IAM role mapping.

sara-partnerships: thanks. rachel, verify Dedicated pool headroom and whether we should reserve capacity.

rachel-ops: today we have ~2 spare A100s in apac region. can do a 30d temporary reserve for the partner if legal clears CMK entitlements. otherwise we'll allow burst into shared pool with cost tier C limits.

anika-legal: CMK usage is covered under current MSA but we require an audit-log push to our compliance bucket and a signed non-export consent from partner. I'll send templates to sara.

ben-infra: provider ticket payload ready, will submit once devin confirms provider mapping. payload (to paste into provider portal):
```
partner_account: cloudscale-p-993
region: apac-sg-2
resources: A100-80GB-dedicated x4, vGPU-burst x8
justification: marketplace onboarding  120k vGPU hours/month
requested_by: sara-partnerships
```

devin-cloudops: mapping confirmed: PRJ-REDWOOD-APAC2 -> cloudscale-p-993. Ben, you can file.

quota-bot: Ticket Q-48217 created (provider ref PRV-993-2256)  provider ETA 48h.

rachel-ops: runbook for canary:
- reserve 30d temp capacity
- canary 5% traffic for 24h
- monitor latency & errors (model + gateway)
- auto-fallback to euw1 if p50>400ms for 3min
- post-canary retrospective

sara-partnerships: action list: ben submit ticket (IN PROGRESS), anika finalize consent + audit clause (ASSIGNED), sara approve reserve after legal OK (PENDING). I'll tell partner they can shift listing by 48h if needed.

mike-cloudscale: partner ready, aiming for public listing Mon next week but can wait 48h. sending SKU confirmation now.

anika-legal: templates sent to sara via DM. need sign-off before reserve approval.

ben-infra: filed provider ticket Q-48217, provider replied "Provisioning pending capacity review, expected by 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC." Jira PART-7124 updated.

sara-partnerships: great. will update partner after provider decision and schedule 15m handoff with ops on Mon morning. thanks everyone :rocket:
